profile.summary: UCSF is where modern biotech began: Herbert Boyer's recombinant-DNA work led to Genentech, and UCSF scientists such as William Rutter went on to start many of the early Bay Area biotech firms. Today its Mission Bay campus keeps producing companies in chemical biology, programmable cell therapy, CNS medicines and AI-driven single-cell biology.
